title: Square function characterization of Hardy-type spaces
summary: The well-known characterization of Hardy spaces $\mathrm{H}_{p}(\mathbb D)$, $0 0$. As an application to composition operators $C_\varphi$, we derive an exact criterion for the boundedness and compactness of $C_\varphi : \mathcal{B}^ω\to X_A$, where $\mathcal{B}^ω= \{f \mid \sup |f'|/ω< \infty\}$ is the weighted Bloch space with a log-convex radial weight $ω$, generalizing recent results in the one-dimensional setting.
